summary: [standards] The artifacts move code differs from the approved brief and the approval is not on the record. Brief F4 and the F6 table name `ARTIFACTS_MOVE_INCOMPLETE` (retryable no) beside `ARTIFACTS_STORE_INCOMPLETE` (retryable yes) precisely to split the two commands that shared ARTIFACTS_STORE_FAILED; the code, registry, schema, fixture, tests, audit and CHANGELOG say `ARTIFACTS_INCOMPLETE` ('the owner's one code per subject for the move', tests/atip_incomplete.rs AUDIT) and I found that decision in no brief, issue comment or ledger record. The result is two _INCOMPLETE codes under the ARTIFACTS prefix with opposite retryability, which is the shape the one-per-subject rule exists to avoid, and the name no longer says which command it is. The briefs are immutable, so either the code is renamed to ARTIFACTS_MOVE_INCOMPLETE (rename in cli_error.rs, schema_codes.rs, canon.cli.json, the fixture, codestored.feature, CHANGELOG, tests; ARTIFACTS_MOVE_REFUSED is already gone so MOVE is free) or the owner's decision is recorded where the next reviewer can read it. atip.codestored.07 spells the name, so I did not re-sign it.
